aecc3250: Reputation comes above all from sales in {0}, especially of goods the town needs ({1}). Also from council commissions, freight and victories.

0daa7bbd: A trading house lives on the cycle: buy cheap where a good is made, sell dear where it is lacking. This first voyage shows you step by step how it works.

ade347df: You now know the cycle. Freight pays without your own money; your own goods pay more once you know the prices.

c1030da6: In the Market tab, below the list of goods: Orders. Freight costs no money, only hold space. You are paid at the port of destination.

d80cfed4: At the top of the market it says what {0} produces ({1}). That is cheap here. Tap the good, choose the quantity and tap Buy. Leave room for the freight.

c8fde888: Cast off and sail to the freight's destination

ba7ca9b4: Tap Cast off at the bottom right. The list of destinations shows for each port what it produces and what it needs; your freight's destination is marked.

e6459ddb: At the port of destination: Market tab, Orders, Deliver.

a95c9322: Get to know the ports and win reputation in {0}. Whoever knows the prices finds the good voyages.

c7956e00: Every port you call at remembers its prices. After that, the list of destinations in the Map tab shows the best known deal for each destination.
